create_QuestionOfRecentMemories: create a QuestionOfRecentMemories component that asks an LLM agent questions conditioned on its recent memories
build_SelfPerception: build a SelfPerception component that asks an agent what kind of person it is based on recent memories
build_SituationPerception: build a SituationPerception component that asks an agent what kind of situation it is currently in
build_PersonBySituation: build a PersonBySituation component that asks what a person like the agent would do in its current situation
build_CombinedPerception: build a CombinedPerception component that answers self perception, situation perception, and person by situation in one prompt
